name: mond-compat
subtitle: iPadOS Mode with an opt-in hybrid layout test
description: Unsigned mond fork for iPhone 17 / iOS 27.0.1 with confirmed on-disk iPadOS patching, validated diagnostics, working-layout backup export, and an experimental hybrid device-class A/B test. The hybrid layout has not been verified on a physical device and can cause instability or boot loops.

apps.name: mond-compat
apps.subtitle: Working iPadOS and guarded hybrid layout experiment
apps.localizedDescription: Keep the existing iPadOS Mode feature; separately test iPhone DeviceClassNumber=1 with all five iPadOS flags retained. Export a validated backup of the full working iPadOS layout, restore its exact snapshot if the hybrid UI fails, and verify every MobileGestalt write by read-back. This is an experimental test, not a proven UI layout fix.

versions.localizedDescription: Hybrid layout A/B test with exact known-working iPadOS restore.
versions.changelog: Add an opt-in iPhone-class plus five-flag test for iPhone18,3/iOS 27.0.1 without changing the working iPadOS toggle. Capture and verify a complete pre-test class-3 snapshot; export it via Files, restore it exactly, and display the class/flag state in read-only diagnostics. Require original backup and matching layout; verify written bytes before reporting success. Hybrid UI behavior remains unverified; no automatic respring or reboot.
